brief: The 5 scalp habits dermatologists wish you'd adopt this year.

slots.author: Elena Voss, M.D.
slots.subtitle: DERMATOLOGIST APPROVED RITUALS FOR HEALTHIER HAIR

slots.author: Elena Voss, M.D.
slots.title: WASH MINDFULLY
slots.body: Over-washing strips natural oils and disrupts your scalp barrier. Aim for two to three times weekly with a pH-balanced formula. Your roots will feel calmer and less irritated within days.

slots.author: Elena Voss, M.D.
slots.title: EXFOLIATE WEEKLY
slots.body: Product buildup and dead cells clog follicles over time. A gentle chemical exfoliant or soft brush used once weekly keeps the environment clear. Think of it as a facial for your scalp.

slots.author: Elena Voss, M.D.
slots.title: MASSAGE DAILY
slots.body: A two-minute massage with your fingertips boosts circulation and supports healthy growth. It also helps distribute your natural oils along the hair shaft. Make it part of your evening wind-down.

slots.author: Elena Voss, M.D.
slots.title: PROTECT FROM SUN
slots.body: Your scalp burns easily where hair is parted or thinning. Apply sunscreen spray or wear a hat when outdoors for extended periods. Prevention now means healthier follicles later.

slots.author: Elena Voss, M.D.
slots.title: TREAT WITH SERUMS
slots.body: Just like skin, your scalp benefits from targeted active ingredients. Look for niacinamide or salicylic acid to soothe and balance. Consistency matters more than intensity.

slots.author: Elena Voss, M.D.
slots.title: STAY CONSISTENT
slots.body: Results take time because hair growth cycles are slow. Commit to these habits for at least three months before expecting visible change. Healthy scalp rituals are an investment, not an overnight fix.

slots.author: Elena Voss, M.D.
slots.headline: START YOUR RITUAL
slots.body: Ready to transform your scalp? Book a consultation and build a regimen tailored to your hair goals.
